title: "Fig.4"

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(speckle)
library(limma)

sc<-readRDS("data/fixed_annotated_aux.seurat.rds")
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$Class=="Peritoneal endometriosis"))
gc()
sc$has_LA<-sc$LA_per_Sample>0
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(!sc$harmonized_major_cell_type%in%c("Exclude","Erythrocytes")))
sc@meta.data<-sc@meta.data%>%
  mutate(Final_Immune_Cluster_ID=str_replace(Final_Immune_Cluster_ID,"Memmory","Memory")%>%
           str_replace("Gamma-Delta","γδ")%>%
           str_replace("Cells","cells"))
```
# UMAP 
```{r}
#sc <- RunPCA(sc, features = VariableFeatures(object = sc))
#sc <- RunUMAP(sc, dims = 1:10)
Idents(sc)<-sc$harmonized_major_cell_type
pA1<-DimPlot(subset(sc,cells = which(sc$has_LA==FALSE)),raster = F) +NoLegend()+
  stat_density_2d(aes_string(x = "UMAP_1", y = "UMAP_2", fill = "after_stat(level)"), 
                     linewidth = 0.2, geom = "density_2d_filled", 
                     colour = "ivory", alpha = 0.4, n = 150, h = c(1.2, 1.2),
                  breaks= seq(0.01,0.04,0.01)) + 
     scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "A") +ggtitle("no LA")+theme(legend.position = "none")
pA2<-DimPlot(subset(sc,cells = which(sc$has_LA==TRUE)),raster = F) + 
  stat_density_2d(aes_string(x = "UMAP_1", y = "UMAP_2", fill = "after_stat(level)"), 
                     linewidth = 0.2, geom = "density_2d_filled", 
                     colour = "ivory", alpha = 0.4, n = 150, h = c(1.2, 1.2)) + 
     scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "A",) +ggtitle("has LA")

```

# Speckle
```{r}
aux_table<-sc@meta.data
temp<-aux_table%>%filter(!is.na(Final_Immune_Cluster_ID))
props<-getTransformedProps(temp$Final_Immune_Cluster_ID,
                           temp$SampleName)
temp<-aux_table%>%distinct(has_LA,SampleName)
designM<-model.matrix(~0+has_LA,data=temp)#groups around 

props<-props$TransformedProps[,temp$SampleName]
fit<-lmFit(props,designM)
cont<-makeContrasts(has_LATRUE-has_LAFALSE,levels = designM)
fit<-contrasts.fit(fit,cont)
fit <- eBayes(fit, robust=TRUE)
res<-topTable(fit,number = nrow(props),coef = 1)

scalelabels <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)

pB<-res%>%arrange(logFC)%>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_type")%>%
  filter(cell_type!="Exclude")%>%
  mutate(cell_type=factor(cell_type,levels=cell_type))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=logFC,y=cell_type,fill=logFC,size=adj.P.Val))+
  geom_point(shape=21)+
  scale_size(range=c(8,1),transform = "log",labels = scalelabels)+
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)+ggtitle("LA - no LA")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,vjust = 1,hjust = 1))

#temp<-aux_table%>%count(has_LA,harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type,name = "cell_n")%>%
#    group_by(has_LA)%>%
#    mutate(total=sum(cell_n),prop=100*cell_n/total)
#temp<-temp%>%group_by(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type)%>%summarise(cell_n=sum(cell_n),has_LA="Total")%>%ungroup()%>%mutate(total=sum(cell_n),prop=100*cell_n/total)%>%bind_rows(temp%>%mutate(has_LA=as.character(has_LA)))
#p0<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(y=cell_n,x=has_LA,fill=harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type))+geom_bar(stat="identity",position = "fill")+scale_fill_manual(values=unique(c(kelly.colours,cluster.cols)))

pBA<-aux_table%>%count(has_LA,Final_Immune_Cluster_ID)%>%drop_na()%>%
  mutate(Final_Immune_Cluster_ID=factor(Final_Immune_Cluster_ID,
                                        levels=levels(pB$data$cell_type)))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=n,y = Final_Immune_Cluster_ID))+geom_col()+facet_grid(~has_LA)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)+
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,vjust = 1,hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  labs(y="")
pB<-plot_grid(pB+theme(legend.position = "none"),pBA,get_legend(pB),ncol=3,rel_widths = c(.6,.3,.1))
```
# Markers
```{r}
markers<-list(T=c("IL32","CD27","TNFRSF14"),
              Th=c("CCR6","CCR5","CXCR4","IL7R","CCL20","TNFSF13B"),
              Th2="CD40LG",
              B=c("CD40","FAS","IFNGR1"),
              #Mast=c("KIR2DL4","NCAM1"), 
              )
markers<-markers%>%reshape2::melt()%>%mutate(marker=value)%>%select(-value)%>%deframe()

pBC<-DotPlot(subset(sc,cells = which(!is.na(sc$Final_Immune_Cluster_ID)&sc$has_LA==FALSE)),features = markers)+RotatedAxis()+
pBD<-DotPlot(subset(sc,cells = which(!is.na(sc$Final_Immune_Cluster_ID)&sc$has_LA==TRUE)),features = markers)+RotatedAxis()+scale_colour_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")
temp<-pBC$data%>%mutate(has_LA=FALSE)%>%bind_rows(pBD$data%>%mutate(has_LA=TRUE))

```
